laws.rule: Catamarca’s official mountain-ascent portal says both sporting and guided commercial mountain expeditions must submit an ascent registration before entering the area, including the expedition plan and participants. Confirm the current process and route-specific requirements with provincial authorities.

Catamarca’s official mountain-ascent portal says guides on commercial expeditions must be registered in the provincial mountain-guides register and hold personal accident and public liability insurance covering clients and their service.
